purpose: A conventional latent-state model with no task specification, for the intervention study's decomposition of latent states and specification: a latent neural ODE driven by the measured inputs (augmented neural ODE with an encoder of the initial readings), on the two cells the study scores, Phase C CSTR-hard and T2-hard, with seeds 0, 1 and 2. Public training trajectories fit it; public validation trajectories stop training early and choose the latent dimension. Settings are common neural ODE defaults, fixed before any model was trained and before any intervention score was seen; frozen on 2026-11-11 on the user's sign-off.
